X.coordinate: Executable synthetic Causal IR layer after PH-D02B schema closure and before PH-D03 Golden/Sealed corpus freeze, PH-D05 real trajectory normalization, or PH-D06 candidate generation

R.risk: An untyped or open-ended graph, implicit selector first-choice, unknown or reordered opcode, hidden Python execution, silent invalid-operation correction, unbound ABI, answer-copy literal, identity routing, exact-fit causal overclaim, or resource overflow converted to FAIL would make later distillation evidence non-auditable and allow replay-shaped mechanisms to masquerade as general causal structure.
R.required_response: Fail closed with stable codes on unknown type, value/type mismatch, unknown or version-mismatched opcode, malformed or cyclic references, forward reference, unresolved input, precondition failure, selector cardinality mismatch, invalid parameters or operations, ABI digest mismatch, answer-copy or identity-routing fields, causal-overclaim state, and unauthorized side effects. Preserve node order exactly. Return SUSPEND_RESOURCE with HOLD and INCONCLUSIVE on resource exhaustion rather than FAIL or causal rejection.
R.claim_boundary: DISTILLATION_IR_EXECUTABLE may establish only that the declared synthetic IR subset type-checks and executes deterministically under the frozen ABI and registries, while DG-03, DG-08, DG-09, and DG-12 fail closed at this boundary. It does not establish exact fit on teacher data, causal mechanism support, safe real interventions, corpus conformance, Rule promotion, structure-bundle approval, Bridge readiness, AGI capability, or official readiness.

Mc.mechanism: A canonical contract fixes eighteen common data types, thirty-three ARC2 opcodes, eighteen ARC3 opcodes, complete Operator Registry Entry metadata, graph-node syntax, resource accounting, and Code/IR ABI digests. A dependency-free loader validates contract and registry bytes, a static linter rejects privileged routing and answer-copy structures, a type checker resolves declared values and ordered node references, and a pure interpreter dispatches only registered built-ins while emitting canonical execution traces and digests. Exact comparison and synthetic intervention execution are exposed through bounded interfaces without source access or causal promotion.
Mc.owner_authority: 大平鉄兵 remains the sole Rule, promotion, bundle, locked-final, official, and submission decision authority.
Mc.rollback: Revert PH-D02C-owned commits only; preserve PH-D02A canonical artifacts, the sealed PH-D02B evidence snapshot and artifact manifest, the thirty-eight-name schema inventory, all source bytes and external archives, pre-existing P22/CV worktree changes, and all prior phase evidence.
